decisions.what: Requirements are docs/product.md Lite column; no requirements-analyst spawn
decisions.why: the product page already fixes every requirement and was reviewed in PR #3; the person said decide everything

decisions.what: Research done inline from vendor datasheets (TPA3118D2 SLOS708G, CH224 DS V2.0, ES8388 rev 5.0, TPS54302 SLVSDG6C, ESP32-LyraT v4 schematic) instead of researcher spawns
decisions.why: pinouts and reference values come straight from the datasheets, saved in parts/datasheets.md

decisions.what: CH224Q (not CH224K) for the PD sink, Rset 120k = 20 V
decisions.why: CH224K has 1 in stock at LCSC; CH224Q table 5-1 gives 120k for 20 V

decisions.what: CH224Q DP/DM left unconnected; USB D+/D- go only to the CH340C
decisions.why: PD only; BC1.2/QC signalling on D+/D- would fight the CH340C's USB data

decisions.what: PVDD switch Q1 driven by ESP32 GPIO18 through an NPN, not by CH224Q PG directly
decisions.why: PG pulled up to 3.3 V for the ESP32 cannot also sit in a 20 V gate divider; firmware gates PVDD on PG + VBUS sense (plan item 7)

decisions.what: One 5 V buck (TPS54302) then SY8089 3.3 V and LP5907 3.3 V analog
decisions.why: TPS54302 is a TI part with a full design example; SY8303 had no known-good pinout source here

decisions.what: ESP32 pin map follows the ESP32-A1S AudioKit (I2S 0/27/25/26/35, I2C 32/33)
decisions.why: squeezelite-esp32 supports that board with the ES8388 out of the box

decisions.what: TPA3118D2 gain 26 dB (20k/100k), BD mode, 400 kHz, no power limit, SE drive with INN AC-grounded
decisions.why: ES8388 full scale ~0.9 Vrms x 20 = clipping at 20 V into 4 ohm; TI table 1

decisions.what: Speaker outputs on a 4-way 5.08 mm screw terminal (DB128V, 16 A) instead of 4 GC4010-F
decisions.why: GC4010-F has no EasyEDA CAD data and is an RC bullet connector, not a PCB banana socket; binding posts go on the enclosure, wired to the terminal (product.md open item 4)

decisions.what: One GND net, B.Cu pour; amp and codec separated by placement
decisions.why: 2-layer board; split grounds on 2 layers make return paths worse

decisions.what: Passives use KiCad stock 0603/0805/1206 footprints with JLC Basic LCSC parts; everything else from EasyEDA via lib_pull
decisions.why: EasyEDA 0603 courtyards are the body outline (hwde-led-test LEARNINGS)

decisions.what: Pin electrical types blanket-retyped to passive (lib_pin_types without extracts); every rail carries a PWR_FLAG
decisions.why: no datasheet_extract JSONs were made; ERC then passes 0/0

decisions.what: Outline 100 x 90 mm (not 80): fixed WxH, 4 M3 plated holes, 2 mm corners
decisions.why: 100 x 80 left no room for the PVDD switch network between USB-C and the amp output stage; still under JLC's 100 x 100 price step

decisions.what: Placement by explicit op list (kicad/gen/place.py -> place_edit), not place_seed/anneal
decisions.why: rear/front edge assignment, antenna-at-edge and the amp output row facing the speaker terminal are product layout decisions; the op list is re-appliable after board_init

decisions.what: Amp channel swap: TPA3118 'right' channel drives the LEFT speaker
decisions.why: the output row then runs L+ L- R+ R- straight into the terminal with no crossing; nets are named by speaker channel

decisions.what: Schematic review findings dispositioned in reports/review-schematic-response.md (1 error fixed, 9 warnings fixed or mitigated, 5 accepted with reasons)
decisions.why: fresh-context review 2026-10-28

decisions.what: No USB ESD array on the Lite tier
decisions.why: cost-first tier; CH340C/CH224Q have on-chip ESD; Plus/Ultra add USBLC6-2SC6

decisions.what: VBUS and PVDD carried by pours (F.Cu VBUS, B.Cu+F.Cu PVDD islands, 17 transition vias); tracks only for taps (1.5 A class)
decisions.why: a 2.38 mm per-net width rule is unmeetable at the USB-C, DFN and HTSSOP pads (pad-window probe); pours carry the 5 A

decisions.what: OUT_* (amp pin to inductor) sized for 1.2 A rms, 0.44 mm; SPK_* (inductor to terminal) for 3.5 A, 1.5 mm
decisions.why: the HTSSOP pins at 0.65 mm pitch cannot take a wider track with 0.2 mm clearance; 1.2 A is the rms of music at full power (crest factor 9 dB); the OUT runs are under 15 mm

decisions.what: USB D+/D- routed as ordinary nets (diff_pairs empty)
decisions.why: 12 Mb/s full speed; 90 ohm on 1.6 mm 2-layer needs a 1.09 mm pair route_critical could not fit; length under 80 mm is fine at FS

decisions.what: route_critical skipped
decisions.why: KRT power routing shorted into the VBUS/PVDD pours (41 shorting items, rolled back); diff pair dropped above

decisions.what: U8 check_thermal waived (signed in reports/verify-waivers.json); bring-up must measure
decisions.why: hwde's copper model ~47 C/W vs TI datasheet 22 C/W on its 2-layer EVM; both pours, 16 solid EP vias, OTP + FAULTZ read by firmware

decisions.what: PVDD from Q1 drain on a B.Cu column; R16 moved out of the PVDD pour
decisions.why: verify: speaker lines cut the F.Cu strip to zero width; bleeder hung on a zero-width sliver

decisions.what: IR receiver IRM-3638T front-facing (THT); PVDD/11 sense on GPIO39
decisions.why: enclosure worker: top-looking receiver 31 mm under the lid; firmware worker: confirm the PVDD switch closed
